required_evidence: Target-box unit must be explicitly defined as a public-post-office-centered sampled target box with fixed latitude/longitude bounds and versioned target construction.
current_evidence_gap: Current selected wave uses target boxes but not a complete national or stratum frame.
implementation_path: Reuse the existing target-box construction script after frame extraction; version any changed box radius, geocoder, or seed semantics.
validation_gate: Every frame row has target_id, seed facility, center coordinate, target bounds, state, stratum, and source lineage.
allowed_after_gate: Target-box frequency within the defined frame.
blocked_until_gate: City, ZIP, ZCTA, parish, catchment, or trade-area frequency.
claim_boundary: Frequency applies only to the declared target-box frame.

required_evidence: Choose national full frame, regional stratum frame, or explicitly scoped multi-stratum frame before estimating frequency.
current_evidence_gap: No current complete public-post-office frame exists for national or stratum inference.
implementation_path: Create a frame manifest that enumerates all eligible public-post-office seed rows for the chosen scope before sampling or census review.
validation_gate: Frame manifest row counts reconcile to seed extraction, semantic filtering, deduplication, and exclusion rules.
allowed_after_gate: Frequency for the chosen frame scope only.
blocked_until_gate: Any broader region or nation outside the declared frame.
claim_boundary: Frame scope must travel with every estimate.

required_evidence: Define which USPS/OSM/public-post-office records are eligible and which private shipping, annex, finance, campus, contract, or semantic edge cases are excluded.
current_evidence_gap: Current selected wave has semantic gates but not a complete frame-wide semantics policy.
implementation_path: Promote the seed-semantics review rules into a versioned frame-semantics contract and run it across the chosen frame.
validation_gate: Semantic status counts and excluded-row examples are reviewed before target construction.
blocked_until_gate: Claims over all postal-like labels or private shipping locations.

required_evidence: Pick full-frame census review or probability sample before execution.
current_evidence_gap: Current selected manifest is purposive and cannot be retrofitted into a probability sample.
implementation_path: If census: review every eligible frame target. If probability: define strata, sample sizes, random seed, inclusion probabilities, and nonresponse/exclusion handling before drawing rows.
validation_gate: Design file records sampling seed, draw method, inclusion probability, and finite-population stratum size for every sampled row.
allowed_after_gate: Weighted or full-frame target-box estimates only after the draw/census is complete and validated.
blocked_until_gate: Unweighted regional or national prevalence from purposive rows.
claim_boundary: Do not mix selected-wave rows into probability estimates unless they were drawn by the design.

required_evidence: Define strata before sampling: candidate options include Census region, rurality/settlement proxy, remoteness, state group, or public-post-office density.
current_evidence_gap: Current strata are evidence-organization labels, not sampling strata with frame sizes.
implementation_path: Build a stratum assignment table for every frame row, then review minimum frame counts and expected precision before sampling.
validation_gate: Every frame row has exactly one primary stratum and documented optional secondary labels.
allowed_after_gate: Stratum estimates only for strata with frame sizes and valid sample/census treatment.
blocked_until_gate: Stratum rates from one purposive manifest row.
claim_boundary: Strata are design variables, not narrative labels.

required_evidence: For probability sampling, each sampled row must have a known nonzero inclusion probability.
current_evidence_gap: No inclusion probabilities exist for current manifest rows.
implementation_path: Use simple random, stratified random, PPS, or two-stage design with formulae recorded before sample draw.
validation_gate: Audit confirms pi values, weights, and row-selection hashes for all sampled rows.
allowed_after_gate: Weighted point estimates and design-based uncertainty if all other gates pass.
blocked_until_gate: Confidence intervals or margins of error without design weights.
claim_boundary: Required only for probability path; census path uses complete enumeration.

required_evidence: Define numerator, denominator, exclusions, weights, finite-population correction, and variance estimator before reporting frequency.
current_evidence_gap: Current artifacts define descriptive numerator/denominator only for selected wave.
implementation_path: Write estimator spec for candidate share, class shares, exclusion handling, and uncertainty; include formulas and reproducible script target.
validation_gate: Dry-run estimator on current selected wave as non-inferential test data; block inferential labels until probability/full-frame data exist.
allowed_after_gate: Frequency estimates with stated estimator and uncertainty for probability path; exact frame share for census path.
blocked_until_gate: Ad hoc percentages without estimator provenance.
claim_boundary: Estimator scope must match frame and sampling path.

required_evidence: Define how source-gated, current-anchor-failed, private-shipping, seed-mismatch, and operations-gated rows affect denominator and numerator.
current_evidence_gap: Current selected-wave source gate exists but needs promotion into frame-wide policy.
implementation_path: Reuse denominator exclusion ledger categories and predeclare whether each is denominator exclusion, numerator exclusion, repair queue, or sensitivity case.
validation_gate: Exclusion ledger summary reconciles to frame/sample totals and sensitivity table if needed.
allowed_after_gate: Estimates with transparent exclusions and optional sensitivity bounds.
blocked_until_gate: Frequency claims that hide source-gated or operations-gated rows.
claim_boundary: Exclusion policy must be stable before estimation.

required_evidence: Define required source review depth for every numerator candidate and for sampled non-candidates if auditing false negatives.
current_evidence_gap: Current hardened packets cover only current 9 selected-wave survivors.
implementation_path: Specify source types, recency checks, current-anchor verification, geocoding standards, and contradiction handling for every candidate in the designed frame/sample.
validation_gate: Every numerator candidate has source-review rows, decision row, and synthesis class; audit sample of non-candidates passes false-negative check if required.
claim_boundary: Depth review authorizes target-box classes only.

required_evidence: Define primary and fallback geocoders plus rules for rural addresses, unresolved points, and conflicting source coordinates.
current_evidence_gap: Current work uses Census geocoder, Geofabrik/OSM geometry, and Nominatim fallbacks case by case.
implementation_path: Write a geocoder precedence contract and require geocode_source for every source row used in numerator decisions.
validation_gate: Geocode audit identifies unresolved, fallback, and conflict rows before estimation.
allowed_after_gate: Target-box inside/outside decisions with reproducible geocode provenance.

required_evidence: Predeclare allowed and blocked wording for each design path.
current_evidence_gap: Current language gate blocks broad claims but does not yet define post-design wording.
implementation_path: Extend frequency-language decision gate after design selection and estimator implementation.
validation_gate: Review packet contains allowed statement templates and blocked overclaims.
allowed_after_gate: Only the approved wording for the selected design path.
blocked_until_gate: Smallest postal parish, service adequacy, catchment isolation, or customer behavior unless separately designed.
claim_boundary: Reporting language must match evidence scope.

required_evidence: No regional, stratum, or national frequency work proceeds until frame scope and sampling/census path are selected.
current_evidence_gap: Current state has no selected frame scope or design path.
implementation_path: Choose design path, create frame manifest, and implement estimator/validation scripts.
validation_gate: All required design rows are pass or explicitly out of scope with rationale.
blocked_until_gate: Regional, stratum, or national frequency from current selected wave.
claim_boundary: Current allowed claim remains selected-wave descriptive 9/128.
